name: LangGraph (Python)
description: Low-level graph runtime for stateful agents; checkpointers (in-memory, SQLite, Postgres) enable human-in-the-loop and fault tolerance. MCP is provided separately by langchain[mcp] (beta), so supports_mcp is not set.

provenance.notes: version 1.2.15 uploaded 2026-10-12; requires_python >=3.10; supports programming_languages python
MIT license; JS/TS is a separate library (LangGraph.js), not covered by this version
supports_tool_execution: LangGraph prebuilt ToolNode/tools_condition executes tool calls (LangChain-authored example)
